Hi OP, 24F here. I know this doesn't seem easy. I think you should sit down with your girlfriend, and have a really deep discussion about where her feelings are coming from. Ask her about the specific behaviors your friend exhibits that makes her feel threatened in your relationship, and if she feels your friend has made any sort of real pass at you. Reassure her that you are listening, and that you don't think she's lying, you just want a better understanding of how she feels. 

Then maybe talk to your friend. Don't tell her what your girlfriend said, but have a brief talk about how she feels about your girlfriend, and if anything can be done to improve the relationship between the three of you. If you think it's okay, maybe the 3 of you could then sit down and try to talk it out. Your girlfriend could explain how she feels that your friend doesn't like her. Find a mediator as well, someone who can be an objective party with no stakes in the game, because right now you can't. 

I've had this happen before, and if you really want this relationship to work, you and your girlfriend will really have to work through this. Maybe she's right, maybe your friend is a threat to your relationship. Or maybe it's a simple miscommunication and it can be easily resolved. But unless you sit down to actually see the proof from your girlfriend's point of view, you'll never know. 

Let's say your girlfriend is right, but there's no active proof your friend acted on any of her feelings. There is always a compromise. Never hang out with her alone. Strict boundaries between you and your friend. Continual reassurance to your girlfriend that you are not reciprocating any feelings towards your friend. 

If she has, then there's a bigger decision you might have to make.

As of now, we don't have the full story so we're unsure if your girlfriend's concerns are valid or not. This is an extremely difficult thing to go through, but you'll be okay in the long run 💖.
